harness: scripts/sweep_optimized_decoder.py (traced warmed decode, batch 1, context 4096, sliding_rope, synthetic real-scale weights, 32 replays; prefill 8192 tokens, 3 warmed iterations)
notes: Decode candidates are comparable across sections: the decode path never uses the 2D prefill matmul, so the prefill program-config fix did not change any decode number.

Prefill candidates are only from after the DRAM-sharded-weight grid_x fix; earlier prefill timings were collected on a configuration that silently returned NaN (see scripts/repro_prefill_matmul_grid_x9.py) and are excluded rather than published.

Six repeats of the shipped configuration in one process measured 1.0632/1.0792/1.0776/1.0775/1.0806/1.0764 ms - 1.6% peak-to-peak, first repeat consistently fastest. Sweep position therefore biases a single measurement by more than a 1-2% effect, so differences below ~1.7% are ties unless they were re-measured paired (see the 'Paired re-measurements' section).

Every candidate measured after the second stage review is PCC-gated in the same loop (PCC_SEQ in scripts/sweep_optimized_decoder.py). Earlier rows are wall-clock only; the shipped configuration is independently PCC-gated by the test suite.
